ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is the midpoint of segment AB, point D is the midpoint of segment AC, and DB equals 9. What is the length of AB?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of AB,\\
it follows that AC=BC,\\
Since point D is the midpoint of the segment AC,\\
it follows that AC=BC=2AD=2DC\\
Since DB=9,\\
it follows that DC+BC=9,\\
it follows that DC+2DC=9,\\
Solving this gives: DC=AD=3,\\
Therefore, AB=AD+BD=3+9=\boxed{12}.
